items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I can’t think of anybody off the top of my head, except like Hampton Hawes or . . .

ctx.x: Well even after you came on the scene too. Those of us who’ve come on, are there, you can see where you’ve influenced this either though educational arena as well as . . .

Yeah, well. That’s awful. I can’t think of anybody off the top of my head, except like Hampton Hawes or . . . God, my head is so filled with Phineas and Bud. There were a lot of other guys. The minute you leave the house I’ll think of ten of them.
